newsitem.title: USA: Jones Med up as small drug stocks rise.
newsitem.headline: Jones Med up as small drug stocks rise.

text.p: Shares in Jones Medical Industries Inc rose sharply on Tuesday amid a rally in small drug company stocks.
Jones was up four to 43 in afternoon trading, while Dura Pharmaceuticals Inc gained two to 34, Forest Laboratories Inc added 3/4 to 40-1/8, Elan Corp advanced 3/4 to 31-1/4.
"Small niche (pharmaceutical stocks are) getting a little bit of a boost today," said ABB Aros Securities analyst David Maris.
A spokeswoman at Jones Medical said the company knew of no reason for the 10 percent jump in its stock and had issued no news.

Analysts also said they knew of no particular news or rumors triggering the stock. They cited possible speculation that Jones might make a drug acquisition following Dura's acquisition last week of U.S. marketing rights to two Eli Lilly and Co antibiotics.
"The fundamentals of the (Jones Medical) story are still very strong," said Robert Stephens analyst Don Ellis. "I don't think there's anything materially different today."
Jones Medical is a volatile stock that often makes large percentage jumps up or down.
Jones and Dura were also mentioned in the September issue of the Wall Street Journal's SmartMoney magazine in an article titled "Bargain Stocks to Buy Now."
